verdict.rationale: First-party docs describe Coinbase Onramp, which lets end users buy crypto with a card, Apple Pay, Google Pay, or a Coinbase account, delivered directly to their wallet. Related docs cover fiat-to-crypto onramp generally and buying USDC through Onramp specifically. Missing for 10: explicit evidence of bank-transfer (ACH/SEPA) funding for onramp purchases, documentation of the embeddable widget or integration mechanics, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
